description:
Su-Yeon is troubled with her boyfriend, who is always abusive and violent. Then, Ju-Hwan appears in front of Su-Yeon. He was her junior in the same club a long time ago. Su-Yeon is surprised that Ju-Hwan's once blunt personality has become sly, and she opens up to him candidly when drunk. Then, they end up going home together...
